label: prf:topological-mass-holonomy
title: Proof that the descended term equals the unknot-core holonomy
html:
Proof. Proof that the descended term equals the unknot-core holonomy

Proof. The projection \hat{\tau}_n(\alpha) lies in \mathcal{A}_{n+1}^{\mathrm{desc}} = \mathrm{im}\hat{\tau}_n, which is isomorphic to the level-n section algebra via the ascent embedding \ell_n (descent involution). The surface \Sigma with \partial\Sigma = \varrho decomposes under the topological blow-up as \Sigma = \Sigma_0 \cup \bigcup_{i=1}^N D_i, where \Sigma_0 is a disc spanning the unknot core \varrho_0 and each D_i is the disc (exceptional divisor) inserted at the i-th blow-up. On \Sigma_0 the transient component vanishes (\alpha - \hat{\tau}_n(\alpha) = 0 on the unknot complement, since \varrho_0 has trivial topology and all sections there factor through level n). Hence:

  \mathrm{MI}\!\!\int_\Sigma \hat{\tau}_n(\alpha)
  = 
  \mathrm{MI}\!\!\int_{\Sigma_0} \alpha
  = 
  \mathrm{Hol}_{\nabla_A}\!\bigl(\varrho_0; \mathfrak{G}\bigr),

where the second equality is the nonabelian Stokes theorem [yekutieli2015] applied to the disc \Sigma_0. \square
